    if len(terms) == 1:

    def _model(self, extra=()):

        if extra:

        model = sol.model() if res == z3.sat else None

        if extra:

            model = opt.model()
            value = model.eval(expr, model_completion=True).as_long()

            value = None
        opt.pop()
